# AutoSync updated logs use URI values instead of folderName temporaries

The changed logs use MOZ_LOG_FMT and folder->URI().get() directly. The removed folderName temporaries held URIs, so the direct accessor makes the actual value clearer. Keep the folder owner valid in the affected branch; this is a local accepted logging pattern, not a global ban on temporary variables or a blanket null-safety claim.

Scope: AutoSync C++ diagnostic naming and formatting.
